**[R1] maxsplit parameter**: Added keyword-only `maxsplit` parameter to `sliced`, `split_after`, `split_at`, `split_before`, and `split_when`. All functions correctly limit the number of splits when specified.

**[R2] keep_separator in split_at**: Added keyword-only `keep_separator` parameter (default=False) to `split_at`. When True, delimiter items are included in the preceding chunk.

**[R3] zip_equal raises UnequalIterablesError**: Created `UnequalIterablesError` exception class and `zip_equal` function that iterates through both inputs simultaneously, raising the error when lengths differ. Both are exported in `__all__`.

**[R4] stagger handles edge cases**: The `stagger` function correctly handles empty iterables, single elements, negative/positive offsets, `longest=True`, and propagates exceptions from generators. No code changes were needed.

All 389 existing tests pass. STATUS.json has been written at the repository root with probability scores of 0.95 for each requirement.
